input.objective:
Pupate heartbeat (IMD launch #1434, Ethereum mainnet, chain id 1). Pupate is a token whose 6% trading tax buys Identity MD seats; the seats work in the IMD swarm until they sell, and what they sell for buys PUPATE and burns it. Nobody holds keys: every duty of the vault is a public function, and buySeat and burn pay the caller 0.5% of the ETH they spend.

Addresses: PUPATE token 0x59fb66660626a6a2c7e0e1a39af1367d09ed92b0; PupateHook 0xb5e544166144a590e171bf0350e8f227858318cc (collects the tax); Cocoon, the vault, 0x54993066369e57a49215f6fc2D9911a8e5a57a79; FloorFeed 0x5A215aa9883cEfE5fa74085ba66288388b83700C (the reference price); TimelockController 0x8bE826082c0FbAeC485048aA26ef42aC147898EC; PupateVesting 0xF0fe8B9a80366469F7FE6C82dF61330b3682B048; Uniswap v4 pool id 0xd4cd0ab2c332b918dae711bbb0a7ac24cd5dd80dabbd3c92c196388c45eca8a7 (ETH/PUPATE, fee 12500, tick spacing 60) on the PoolManager 0x000000000004444c5dc75cB358380D2e3dE08A90. Site https://pupate.fun (skill.md: every duty with cast commands; status.json, listings.json, work.json: the keeper's live view while it runs). Code https://github.com/pupate-IMD/PUPATE.

Each run: read the chain at one pinned block, name the block and its time, and write artifacts/report.md with these parts, short and concrete:
1. LETTER, at the very top and marked LETTER: one plain-English text of at most 280 ASCII characters, written as the swarm speaking to PUPATE holders: what happened since the last letter and what the swarm will do next.
2. METRICS at the pinned block: tax collected (PupateHook.totalTax; Flushed and TaxDeposited events); the four pots (seatPot, burnPot, developerBalance, imdBurnBalance) and mode(); burns (Burned events: count, ETH spent, PUPATE burned, callers, rewards) and PUPATE burned in all (1,000,000,000 minus totalSupply); seats held (heldCount and the Seat* events) with each seat's cost, its listing price now and its work from work.json; harvest and IMD auctions (auctions, imdAuction and their events); the feed (floorWei, issuedAt, fresh, whether a report is due); holders and the pool's swap count and ETH volume if an indexer or explorer gives them; and the change in each figure since the previous report (the first run: since the open, 2026-10-12 16:08 UTC).
3. WHAT WORKS AND WHAT DOES NOT, in plain words: is tax flowing, are the duties being run and by whom, is the feed fresh, is the keeper alive (status.json keeper.lastTickAt).
4. DUTIES DUE NOW: for every public function that would go through at the pinned block (flush, burn, settleSeat, adopt, the auction openers and takers, report, buySeat) one ready cast send line with the real address and arguments and the reward it pays, so any reader can run it; for buySeat name the qualifying Seaport listing (token id, price, offerer) instead of calldata. Say so plainly when nothing is due.
5. ONE IMPROVEMENT: the single best next improvement, to the site or to an opt-in side contract, never to the core contracts (token, hook, Cocoon, FloorFeed, timelock, vesting), with a ready-to-paste prompt for an IMD job that would build it.

Rules: every number comes from the chain, from pupate.fun's feeds or from IMD's own records, each with its source and block; say what you could not read instead of estimating. Make no claim about returns, price or value, and give no advice. Do not edit, redeploy or propose changes to the contracts. Do not send transactions; write the commands for others. When you compare, cite the previous report.
